description_expanded: OverviewPrivate Pool - 4 bikes - Public Beach - 2 Minute Walk - `The Blue Dolphin`The Space✨QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:✔ 400 Steps to the Beach – Campbell Street Access✔ 1.5 Miles to Seaside – Easy bike ride or quick drive✔ Private Pool – Cool off & unwind (no heat option)✔ Gas Grill – Perfect for outdoor cookouts✔ Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected✔ 4 Bikes Included – Explore 30A with ease✔ Driveway - 2 Cars – Hassle-free parking✔ Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest Support🏠Welcome to The Blue DolphinBlue Dolphin is a secluded retreat tucked away from all the activity north of the sand. When your party wants to be playful, swim in the small private pool or take 400 steps to the public dune walkover. The three-story cottage that sleeps 11 has Gulf skyline views. Inside the open living area, you’ll notice porpoise artwork throughout. The u-shape kitchen allows all guests space to lend a hand preparing meals. Double breakfast bars seat eight. With a backyard view, the reading nook creates a cozy spot. One king guest room finishes up the main floor. The middle floor king master, sitting area and private bath opens to an east-facing balcony. Additional guests will have a choice of a second king room or triple bunk room. Upstairs is the lounge and bar with a full sleeper sofa. There is a full bathroom and balcony on this third floor. Beyond the front porch rockers is Blue Dolphin, your escape from day-to-day life.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (11):*King bed in 1st floor guest room; private bath; TV*King bed in 2nd floor master; private bath; TV*King bed in 2nd floor guest room; shared hall bath; TV*Bunk with trundle in 2nd floor guest room; shared hall bath; TV*Full sleeper sofa in 3rd floor loungeAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
